title: 技能：定制包里的相关列表标签页标题现在会按翻译对显示，更新「重写一遍 owner 的 label」这条唯一解法（接 #37622）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` on PR #38085 (#37622). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:ux · Docs · p3 · reach: agents and developers translating a customer package that re-arranges a parent object's related-list tabs · evidence: PR #38085 body, Risk section.
Dedupe: "_relatedLists skills label", "relatedLists arrangement translation skill" → only #37622 (the code fix this follows).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：技能里讲，定制包改了相关列表标签页的标题后，要想让它显示译文，唯一办法是把 owner 原来的标题照抄回去。#37622 合入后，记录页会按定制包自己的翻译显示任何标题，所以这条说法不再是唯一办法。
- 修法：在两处技能文字里补上新的做法。照抄 owner 标题的办法仍然有效，保留。
- 要你做的：无。

## Ask

1. `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `_relatedLists.{list}` row, and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (the remedy that says to re-state the entry "with the owner's own `label`", l.359 on the PR #38085 head) also teach that the object read translates an arrangement-set tab title through the package's own translations, as PR #38085 does.
2. The token ratchet rows move only by the measured delta.

## Acceptance

- Both files describe both routes, and match PR #38085's behaviour as merged.
- Blocked-by: #37622 (PR #38085 must merge first, so the text matches the shipped behaviour).
